question: Which refund window does the policy set?

options.order-date-exclusive: 30 days counted from the order date; a request on day 30 is late
options.delivery-date-exclusive: 30 days counted from the delivery date; a request on day 30 is late
options.delivery-date-inclusive: 30 days counted from the delivery date; a request on day 30 is on time

gold_source: docs/refunds.md in the snapshot: the source of truth, delivery date is day 0, day 30 on time; docs/faq.md defers to it
